templates.title: Select Meaning
templates.action: Choose the Vietnamese meaning of an English word.

explanations.gloss-apologize: “Xin lỗi” is “apologize”. “Appreciate” is about valuing something or being grateful.
explanations.gloss-accept: “Chấp nhận” is “accept” — you can accept help without valuing it.

exercises.feedback: “I really appreciate your help.” — Tôi rất trân trọng sự giúp đỡ của bạn.

exercises.prompt: What does “consider” mean in this sentence?

explanations.clash-decide: Close, but “quyết định” is “decide”. You consider the options before you decide.
explanations.clash-glance: “Xem qua” is a quick look (“look over”). “Consider” means thinking carefully.

exercises.feedback: “Consider” means thinking carefully about something before you decide — cân nhắc.

templates.title: Matching Pairs
templates.action: Pair each English word with its Vietnamese meaning.

exercises.prompt: Tap a word, then tap its meaning.
exercises.feedback: All pairs matched: appreciate — trân trọng, consider — cân nhắc, improve — cải thiện.

templates.title: Word Stack
templates.action: Tap or drag a word into a sentence or phrase.

exercises.context: You are giving a friend advice about their essays.

explanations.stack-tile-happen: “Happen” can’t take an object — practice can’t “happen your writing”.
explanations.stack-tile-depend: “Depend” needs “on” and describes reliance, not making something better.

exercises.feedback: “Improve your writing” — make it better. Improve takes a direct object.

exercises.context: A friend just got a job offer and wants to reply tonight.
exercises.prompt: Take a day to ___ the offer first.

explanations.fill-tile-consist: “Consist” needs “of” and describes what something is made of — you can’t “consist the offer”.
explanations.fill-tile-depend: “Depend” needs “on” — “depend the offer” isn’t grammatical, and it doesn’t mean thinking it over.

exercises.feedback: “Consider the offer” — think about it carefully before deciding.

exercises.context: A friend just helped you move house.

explanations.phrase-tile-arrive: “Arrive” has no object — you arrive somewhere, you can’t “arrive it”.
explanations.phrase-tile-agree: “Agree” needs “with” or “to”, and it means sharing an opinion, not thanking.

exercises.feedback: “Thanks, I really appreciate it!” — Cảm ơn, mình thật sự trân trọng điều đó!

templates.title: Audio Select
templates.action: Play the pronunciation and choose the word you heard.

exercises.prompt: Listen, then choose the word you heard.

explanations.audio-tile-consist: “Consist” ends in /-sɪst/. The word ended with /-sɪdər/.
explanations.audio-tile-confirm: “Confirm” sounds /kənˈfɜːrm/. The middle sound you heard was /sɪd/.

templates.title: Recall Typing
templates.action: Type the word from its meaning — no choices.

exercises.feedback: “Improve” — cải thiện: to make something better.

templates.title: Letter Surgery
templates.action: Find the one wrong letter, then replace it.

exercises.prompt: One letter is wrong. Tap it, then pick the fix.

templates.title: Sound Split
templates.action: Hear the word and tap its stressed syllable.

exercises.feedback: The stress is on the 2nd syllable: ap-PRE-ci-ate /əˈpriːʃieɪt/.

templates.title: Audio Trace
templates.action: Listen and spell the whole word from memory.

exercises.prompt: Listen, then spell the word you heard.

templates.title: Echo Back
templates.action: Listen, repeat it aloud, then check yourself.

exercises.prompt: Listen, say it out loud twice, then mark it done.
exercises.feedback: Self-check only — nothing was recorded or graded. Stress the second syllable: im-PROVE.
